title: On-death effects without a death
problem: Mortal Terror + Feast and Famine can mark a living enemy "cannot be resurrected".
notes: In-game test:  Fix: H | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Enemies that die with Fear cannot be resurrected". H: the on-death death-flag blocks (bc_OnDeath L17-L51 area) should require hp <= 0, so Mortal Terror / Anger Management / Afterlife / Feign Death 'on-death' runs can't mark a living creature. vs bugged: weaker (no false 'cannot be resurrected'). | In-game test: Mortal Terror + Feast and Famine (or Epigraphy / End On a High Note / Burn Their Corpses / Endwalker): an enemy that survives the on-death run can still be resurrected later.

release_notes.effect: On-death effects on survivors (e.g. Mortal Terror with Feast and Famine)
release_notes.intended: Effects such as 'cannot be resurrected' are given to creatures that die.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, an on-death run could mark a creature that was still alive, so it could not be resurrected later.
release_notes.fix: Now these marks only go to creatures that have really died.
